title: Ambient integral Verdier model definitions
statement: On the pro-etale site of a scheme X, with the completed coefficient ring and its positive quotients, define the existing ambient Hom dual functors, normalized signed symmetry, evaluation-transpose delta, restricted dual, reduction comparison, finite dual terms, their restricted comparison isomorphisms, conjugated transition, first limit legs, adjointed finite evaluation, and the dualizing transition. These are the unchanged constructions previously declared in Sheaf.SixFunctors.IntegralVerdier; no existence witness or duality theorem is used to define them.

source.place: Definitions accompanying both paragraphs; no change of mathematical objects.

proof.text: Use the recorded ambient derived Hom and tensor adjunction. Specialize restrictionDualDelta; define all comparisons and transitions by the displayed compositions and scalar-adjunction transposes. These are constructions, with no postponed data or proofs. In comparison, expand the existing IntegralHom comparison and use the definitionally identical scalarReductionDerivedExtension wrapper consistently in its adjunction arguments; the morphism is unchanged.
